entries.title: Sun dasha (6 years)
entries.body: The Sun's period emphasises authority, visibility, relations with the father and superiors, government matters and vitality. When the Sun is strong, recognition and leadership opportunities come forward. When it is weak, the themes are ego conflicts and health of the heart and eyes. The house the Sun rules and occupies directs where these events land.

entries.title: Moon dasha (10 years)
entries.body: The Moon's period emphasises emotions, home, the mother, the public, travel and changes of residence. A strong, waxing Moon brings popularity, comfort and nurturing relationships. A weak Moon calls for care of mental wellbeing. Results follow the houses the Moon rules and occupies.

entries.title: Mars dasha (7 years)
entries.body: Mars's period emphasises action, courage, property, siblings, competition and technical work. It can bring decisive progress, purchases of land or vehicles, and victory over rivals. It also brings the risk of conflict, accidents or surgery if Mars is afflicted. Channel the energy into disciplined goals.

entries.title: Rahu dasha (18 years)
entries.body: Rahu's long period emphasises ambition, unconventional paths, foreign connections, technology and sudden rises. It can amplify whatever house and sign Rahu occupies, and its dispositor largely decides the results. Confusion, restlessness and over-reach are the cautions, and ethical clarity is protective.

entries.title: Jupiter dasha (16 years)
entries.body: Jupiter's period emphasises growth, learning, children, teachers, dharma and prosperity. When Jupiter is well placed, this period is classically among the most fortunate, bringing expansion, marriage or children, and wisdom. The houses Jupiter rules show where the blessing lands.

entries.title: Saturn dasha (19 years)
entries.body: Saturn's long period emphasises discipline, responsibility, work, endurance and structures built to last. When Saturn is well placed it can bring steady rise, authority and lasting achievement. When afflicted it brings delays, fatigue or loneliness that teach patience. Results mature through consistent effort.

entries.title: Mercury dasha (17 years)
entries.body: Mercury's period emphasises learning, communication, trade, writing, technology and adaptability. It is favourable for education, business and travel when Mercury is strong. It calls for grounding against nervous strain when weak. Mercury readily takes on the nature of the planets it joins.

entries.title: Ketu dasha (7 years)
entries.body: Ketu's period emphasises detachment, spiritual inquiry, research and endings that clear space. It can bring sudden changes, loss of interest in old goals, or insight and liberation. Its dispositor and house shape the results, and it is a supportive period for meditation and inner work.

entries.title: Venus dasha (20 years)
entries.body: Venus's long period emphasises relationships, marriage, comfort, the arts, vehicles, luxury and pleasure. A well-placed Venus classically brings happiness, wealth and refinement. A weak or afflicted Venus asks for moderation in indulgence. The houses Venus rules direct its gifts.
